record_type.description: Kind of document. The allowed values are filled in from settings/taxonomy.json.

category_code.description: Top-level category code. The allowed values are filled in from the active categories.

subcategory_code.description: Subcategory of the chosen category, or null. The allowed values are filled in from the active categories.

title.description: Short factual title in the language of the page.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the page text.

published_at.description: Publication date as YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339, or null.

content.description: Main content as clean plain text in the original language.

summary.description: One to three sentences in the language of the page.

keywords.description: 3 to 10 short keywords in the language of the page.

confidence.description: How well the category and subcategory fit, from 0 to 1.
